Title: NEGATIVE — loyalty currency unregistered: createOrderFromCart + order query must NOT crash (PP-01 totals calc + PP-04 per-line currency resolver)
Preconditions: Runner-native + REST setup. @needs-test-data. EXPLICIT PRECONDITION: the loyalty points currency (e.g. XPT/PTS) is NOT registered in the platform currency list (/api/platform/currencies). This is the PP-01 (DefaultCustomerOrderTotalsCalculator allCurrencies.First() throws on an unregistered code) + PP-04 (OrderLineItemType.GetOrderItemCurrency returns null into a NonNull field) scenario. Requires a seeded order whose PTS line carries a currency code absent from AllCurrencies. The fixture does not exist on vcst-qa (loyalty currency IS registered there). Run as a manual/semi-automated probe on a secondary env or after temporarily de-registering the currency in a sandboxed test. Kept Draft/Semi-Automated until the fixture is created. Both invariants-at-risk (BL-ORD-010 and PROPOSED-BL-ORD-011) should survive a currency-registration miss — graceful fallback, not a 500.
Steps:
[AUTH role=LOYALTY_VIP_USER]
[GQL-OP order_offlist]
  query { order(number: "{{OFFLIST_CURRENCY_ORDER_NUMBER}}") { id number currency { code } total { amount currency { code } } orderTotals { isDefaultTotalCurrency total { amount currency { code } } subTotal { amount } } items { id productId currency { code } extendedPrice { amount currency { code } } } } }
[GQL-EXEC order_offlist]
Assertions:
[ERRORS label=order_offlist] errors[] empty
[DATA label=order_offlist] data.order.total.amount >= 0
[DATA label=order_offlist] data.order.orderTotals is non-null
[COUNT label=order_offlist] data.order.orderTotals >= 1
[DATA label=order_offlist] data.order.items.0.currency.code is non-null
Cross_Layer_Checks: [EVIDENCE] @needs-test-data — fixture requires an order with a PTS line whose currency code is absent from the store AllCurrencies list (loyalty currency de-registered). This exercises both crash paths: PP-01 (totals calc .First() on unregistered code) and PP-04 (per-line currency null into NonNull field).
